config.candidate_table_note: 1,320 PDB entries: antibody/nanobody keyword hits released after 2024-09-09 (latest of AF3, Chai-1, ESM3, IgFold, RFAA), one distinct heavy V domain (IMGT/ANARCI screen), >10% normalized Levenshtein distance from train+val heavy chains, full-length IMGT 1-128. This pipeline re-derives everything from the original mmCIF/FASTA and does not reuse the IMGT sequences from that table.

numbering.allowed_species_note: ANARCI default. With all species allowed, ANARCI chose the rhesus HMM for 47 unique heavy sequences and shifted their Chothia numbering (Cys22->H23, Cys92->H94); human+mouse numbers all of them correctly and leaves the other sequences valid.

config.model_selection: lowest pdbx_PDB_model_num present for the chain
config.altloc_rule: residue-level: shared atoms (blank altloc) plus one altloc label; choose label with most backbone atoms having occupancy>0, then highest summed backbone occupancy, then alphabetical
config.representative_rule: per PDB entry and heavy-domain sequence: copy with most complete backbone atoms, ties broken by label_asym_id order
formal_set_requires: mapping_status ok for every residue with coordinates
full submitted sequence available and consistent between FASTA and mmCIF
config.domain_type_rule: VHH if the heavy entity description mentions nanobody/VHH/sybody/single-domain antibody, or the description is only a chain list, the entry title names a nanobody and the entry has no light-chain V domain; VH if no VHH annotation and a light-chain V domain (IMGT classification K/L) exists in the same entry; otherwise unknown. AbNumber H type alone is not treated as VHH evidence.

not_restricted.experimental_method: not restricted (all inputs are experimental PDB entries; method recorded)
not_restricted.structural_completeness_threshold: not restricted (missing residues/atoms are annotated, not filtered)

strict_clean_rules.removed_not_kept: Samples failing any rule below are deleted from the cleaned records (tables, FASTA, alignment, samples/). Only their IDs and reasons are listed in excluded.tsv.
strict_clean_rules.1_heavy_chain_bcr: AbNumber chain type H; entry-level IMGT classification shows no TCR/other V domain in this entity
strict_clean_rules.2_description: entity description names an antibody (heavy/Fab/antibody/nanobody/VHH/scFv/Ig/mAb/Fv/VH/sybody/sdAb/Nb...) and does not call the entity a light chain, TCR, MHC/HLA; descriptions that are only chain lists ('Chains: X') are accepted when the entry title names a nanobody/antibody/Fab; fusion constructs whose description names a non-antibody protein are removed
strict_clean_rules.3_numbering: Chothia H1..H113 complete; Cys at H22 and H92, Trp at H36; insertions only at standard Chothia heavy sites H31, H52, H82, H100 (plus H35)
strict_clean_rules.4_mapping: pipeline status formal (no sequence/structure mismatch, ambiguous mapping, sequence-source conflict; coordinates present)
